page_title: Rethink the Web - Wavebox Productivity Browser

sources.entry: Wavebox - Browser workspace for organizing web apps and team tools.

summary.name: Wavebox
summary.one_liner: Wavebox is a productivity browser that organizes web apps, tabs and multiple accounts of the same service into one workspace.
keywords: slack microsoft teams asana clickup browser
use_cases: Signing into multiple accounts of the same web app without switching browsers
Monitoring messaging, email and notifications in one place
Working across multiple Slack, Teams, Asana or ClickUp accounts
Splitting the screen to view two apps or two Gmail accounts side by side
Onboarding team members with a shared browser setup
Tracking team app usage to reduce software spending
summary.what_it_does: Wavebox lets users organize daily apps and tabs into groups, each with its own tab strip. It supports staying signed in to many accounts of the same type, such as several Gmail, Slack or Microsoft Teams accounts, without switching Chrome profiles. The Wavebox Mini menu lists webmail, messaging and collaboration tools together with unread badges and desktop notifications. Split-screen lets users place resizable pages side by side, including two accounts of the same app. The page also describes an AI assistant (Brainbox) usable from the right-click menu, which can be disabled, and app usage monitoring for spending decisions.
notable: Multi-account sign-in for apps like Gmail, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Asana and ClickUp
Access to Chrome web store extensions plus 20+ built-in features
Brainbox AI assistant usable within the current app or tab, with optional disable
Shared team browser with passwords locked by end-to-end encrypted master password
caveats: Pricing details are not stated on the page; a testimonial mentions a paid subscription
Platform support beyond the browser itself is not clearly listed on the page
